verdict.rationale: Reflect advertises end-to-end encryption of note content (reflect-docs-16, reflect-docs-35), which limits Reflect's own server-side access, but there is no explicit statement anywhere in the evidence about whether note content sent to third-party AI models (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet per reflect-docs-37) is used for model training, nor any opt-out/data-processing policy addressing AI training use. Community evidence even notes files/images are excluded from E2E encryption (reflect-comm-8), raising unaddressed questions rather than resolving them.
